title: Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya to inaugurate 100-bedded ESIC Hospital at Doddaballapur, Karnataka on 3rd May
text:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau

Ministry of Labour & Employment

Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya to inaugurate 100-bedded ESIC Hospital at Doddaballapur, Karnataka on 3rd May

Union Minister to virtually lay foundation stone for 100-bedded ESIC Hospital at Bellary, Karnataka,

Posted On:
01 MAY 2026 3:35PM by PIB Delhi

The Union Minister of Labour & Employment and Youth Affairs & Sports, Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya, will inaugurate the newly constructed 100-bedded ESIC Hospital at Doddaballapur, Karnataka, and lay the foundation stone for a 100-bedded ESIC Hospital at Bellary, Karnataka, remotely from Doddaballapur on 03.05.2026. These healthcare facilities mark a significant milestone in strengthening healthcare delivery under the Employees’ State Insurance (ESI) Scheme in the region.

As a special gesture, Dr. Mandaviya will honour the construction workers who contributed to the development of the hospital and will also disburse cash benefits to ESI beneficiaries during the event. The Doddaballapur facility will serve over 1,42,037 insured workers and their families, benefiting approximately 5.50 lakh beneficiaries across Bengaluru Rural, Chikkaballapur, Tumkuru, and Kolar districts. The Bellary facility, upon completion, will cater to the medical needs of around 64,000 workers and their families, benefitting across 2 lakh beneficiaries in the Bellary Division.

The ESIC Hospital at Doddaballapur, Bengaluru Rural, Karnataka, is a 100-bedded multi-specialty secondary care facility built over 5 acres at a cost of ₹101.14 crore. It includes 32 staff quarters and offers key services such as General Medicine, Surgery, Obstetrics & Gynaecology, Paediatrics, Orthopaedics, emergency care, and comprehensive diagnostic facilities including radiology, laboratory, and blood bank. The proposed ESIC Hospital at Bellary will be developed on 5.21 acres with an estimated cost of ₹150 crore and will provide modern, state-of-the-art healthcare services to insured persons and their families under the ESI Scheme.

The Employees’ State Insurance (ESI) Scheme was introduced in Karnataka in 1958, starting from Bangalore and now covers all 31 districts. As of 31.03.2025, the Scheme includes 2,01,749 employers and 35,33,300 insured persons (including 11,22,118 women), covering a total of 1,37,09,204 beneficiaries. The state has one Regional Office at Binnypeth, Bengaluru, and six Sub Regional Offices. Cash benefits are administered through 48 Branch Offices and 6 DCBOs. Primary care is delivered through 125 ESIS dispensaries, along with DCBOs and employer-run dispensaries. Secondary care services are delivered through 03 ESIC hospitals located at Rajajinagar, Indiranagar, and Gulbarga, along with seven State-run ESIS hospitals. These are further supported by empanelment with 143 hospitals for secondary care and 123 hospitals for super-specialty treatment. Among these 03 ESIC hospitals, the hospital at Rajajinagar, Bengaluru also functions as a Medical College and Postgraduate (PG) Institute. The ESIC hospital at Gulbarga operates as a Medical College and Dental College, while the ESIC hospital at Indiranagar functions as a Nursing College. These institutions offer reserved seats for wards of insured persons, including 136 MBBS seats, 28 Dental seats, 60 Nursing seats, and 96 Paramedical seats annually.

*******

Rini Choudhury/Anjelina Alexander
